## Elephant/Goldfish (EG)

This project uses the EG workflow.

- Profile: `.github/eg/profile.md` (project docs, gate commands, doc path)
- Core protocol: `.github/eg/protocol.md`
- Packs: `.github/eg/packs/`

To start: select the `elephant` agent, then run `/eg-new-feature`, `/eg-fix-bug`, `/eg-prd`, `/eg-brainstorm`, `/eg-precommit-review`, or `/eg-setup`. Put a pack name as the first word to use a pack other than the default, for example `/eg-new-feature general add CSV export`.
<!-- EG:END -->
